title: Meridale Food Bank weekly status
brief: I'm the operations coordinator at Meridale Food Bank and the trustees, who will have this printed for their meeting on 2026-11-02, want a status page for the week ending 2026-10-30. Headline numbers: 812 households served this week against a target of 750, 9.4 tonnes of food given out, 214 volunteer hours, and stock cover of 9 days against our minimum of 14. Under "Households served" chart the last six weeks: W39 690, W40 705, W41 748, W42 790, W43 801, W44 812. Under "Depots" give a table of households, food in kilograms and volunteers: Eastside 301, 3550, 18; Marlow Road 244, 2900, 12; St. Brides Hall 187, 2150, 14; Mobile van 80, 800, 6. Under "Needs attention": Marlow Road has only 3 days of stock cover, and its delivery from the regional warehouse is not due until 2026-11-06, so flag it clearly. Under "Coming up": the winter hamper drive starts on 2026-11-14 with a target of 600 hampers, and the volunteer thank-you evening is on 2026-11-20.

edit.request: Marlow Road's delivery has been brought forward to 2026-11-03, which lifts its stock cover to 8 days. Also change the hamper drive target to 650.
